info.title: Domain WHOIS Lookup API - Well-Structured Registration & Ownership Data
info.description: Retrieve real-time WHOIS registration and ownership data for a domain name directly from its authoritative registrar and registry. Returns registrar details (name, IANA ID, WHOIS/RDAP server, accreditation status), registrant/administrative/technical/billing/reseller contact information, name servers, EPP domain status codes, and both registrar-level and registry-level raw WHOIS text. Pass `domainName` as a bare domain (e.g. `example.com`); a `https://` or `http://` prefix is also accepted. Privacy-protected domains return redirect instructions instead of direct contact emails, and an unregistered domain returns `domain_registered: no` with most fields omitted instead of an error. Domain extensions this API does not support live WHOIS for return a `403` error, and a missing or malformed `domainName` returns a `400` error.

get.summary: Retrieve real-time WHOIS registration and ownership data for a domain name
get.description: Returns the current WHOIS record for the specified domain, including registrar details, registrant/administrative/technical/billing/reseller contacts, name servers, status codes, and raw WHOIS text.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: Domain name to retrieve WHOIS data for (e.g. example.com).

DomainRegistrar.description: Registrar of record for a domain, as published by either the registrar or the registry.

status.description: Registrar's ICANN accreditation status (e.g. accredited), when published at the registrar level.

normalized_name.description: Lowercased, normalized form of the registrar name, when published at the registrar level.

whois_server.description: WHOIS server operated by the registrar, when published.

rdap_server.description: RDAP server URL operated by the registrar, when published at the registrar level.

email_address.description: Registrar abuse or contact email address, when published.

phone_number.description: Registrar contact phone number, when published.

email_address.description: Contact email address, or a privacy-service redirect instruction.
